verdict.rationale: An accounting SaaS could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this story applies, but the evidence documents no in-product AI assistant that accepts delegated tasks. The closest items are Bill Pay's automated bill reading and a human bookkeeping service ('hand off the busywork'). These are adjacent automation and human delegation, not an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
